当你的应用需要从服务端向客户端实时推送消息时，应使用Push Kit
典型场景包括行程提醒、账号动态通知、即时聊天消息推送、网络音视频通话、打车出行状态更新、赛事比分实时更新、应用配置参数更新等
当你需要构建服务端与客户端之间的消息通道时，Push Kit提供了完整的端云对接方案，包括Token获取与上报、服务端鉴权、消息下发与处理
如果仅需在本地推送通知，应使用Notification Kit
接入 Push Kit 并上报设备 Token 到业务服务器 / Integrate Push Kit and upload the device token to the app server
实现应用离线时也能收到系统推送提醒 / Deliver system push alerts even when the app is offline
发送营销活动通知并支持点击跳转到指定页面 / Send promotional push notifications with deep links to a target page
下发静默消息在后台同步配置或刷新数据 / Deliver silent push messages to sync config or refresh data in the background
订阅新闻或频道更新并按主题推送消息 / Subscribe to news or channel updates and push messages by topic
实现订单状态变更提醒如发货到达签收通知 / Notify users of order status changes like shipped, arrived, and delivered
给即时通讯应用添加新消息到达提醒和未读通知 / Add new message arrival alerts and unread notifications for a chat app
推送语音或视频来电邀请并唤起通话界面 / Push voice or video call invitations and bring up the call UI
更新实时活动内容例如比赛比分或骑行导航进度 / Update live activity content such as match scores or ride navigation progress
发送通知后支持撤回消息或清除指定通知 / Support message recall or clearing specific notifications after sending
按用户标签或分组定向发送个性化推送 / Send personalized push notifications by user tags or segments
统计推送送达点击打开效果并分析消息转化 / Track push delivery, clicks, opens, and analyze conversion
preconditions: 已在 AppGallery Connect 为应用开通 Push 服务并完成项目配置 / Push service has been enabled for the app in AppGallery Connect and project configuration is completed
工程已集成 Push Kit 相关 SDK/依赖，且设备与系统版本支持该能力 / The project has integrated Push Kit SDK dependencies, and the device/system version supports the capability
若接收通知类消息，应用已声明所需权限且用户已授予通知授权 / For notification-type messages, required permissions are declared and notification permission has been granted by the user
若要从服务端下发消息，服务端鉴权信息、网络连通性与 Push REST 接口访问条件已具备 / To send messages from the server, server authentication, network connectivity, and Push REST API access conditions are ready
inputs: Push Token或目标设备标识 / Push token or target device identifier
消息负载内容与消息类型 / Message payload content and message type
应用标识、项目配置或服务端鉴权参数 / App identifier, project configuration, or server authentication parameters
通知样式或场景化消息参数 / Notification style or scenario-message parameters

postconditions.statement: 工程中已接入 Push Kit 初始化、Token 获取或消息接收处理相关代码 / The project includes Push Kit initialization, token retrieval, or message receiving handling code
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify HarmonyOS code/config to integrate Push Kit on the client, such as initialization, push token retrieval, or push message callback handling?

postconditions.statement: 已新增或更新与推送服务相关的配置，使应用具备使用 Push Kit 的条件 / Configuration related to push service has been added or updated so the app is able to use Push Kit
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include project/module configuration changes required for Push Kit, such as SDK dependencies, service configuration, or permission-related setup?

postconditions.statement: 若任务涉及云侧下发，已补充调用 Push REST 接口所需的请求构造或鉴权示例 / If the task involves server-side delivery, the required request construction or authentication example for Push REST APIs is added
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task is about sending push messages from a server, do the edits include code or documentation showing how to authenticate and construct a Push REST API request?
